minutes.headline: Conservation Commission continued most hearings to July 7 and approved a dealership building NOI
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission held its first hybrid in-person and Zoom meeting and worked through a long slate of wetlands hearings. Negative determinations were voted for a dock, a hemlock removal and a pine removal. A notice of intent for a commercial building at 757 Chase Road and a certificate of compliance were approved, and most other hearings were continued to July 7 or July 21. An alleged violation at 23 Cove Road was given about 60 days for a filing.

public_comment.topic: Litter flowing from a drain at Route 70 and Leominster Road into a wetland; asked about a screen. Chair said he would talk to DPW about a plunge pool.
Abutter at 141 Beale Street asked whether grade changes would affect his property.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission approved a notice of intent for a commercial building at 757 Chase Road, with a state slope mix condition.
Most other wetlands hearings were continued to July 7 or July 21, among them 163 Beale Street, 250 Howard Street, the Flat Hill Road bridge and 48 Pearl Street.
Negative determinations were voted for a roll-out dock at 90 Wilder Road, tree work at 39 Cliff View Terrace, and tree removal at 73 Peninsula Drive.
The owner of 23 Cove Road, an alleged violation, was given until the first September meeting, about 60 days, to submit an application.
The agent must file for trails grant reimbursement, or the cost falls against the town's free cash; the next meeting will be on Zoom.

why_it_matters: The Commission decides whether building near wetlands and water can go ahead, so the Chase Road approval and the many continued hearings set when nearby projects can start.
An unfiled trails grant reimbursement would leave the cost to the town's free cash, which is money otherwise available for other town needs.
watch_next: The July 7 meeting, on Zoom, where most continued hearings return.
The first September meeting, the deadline for the 23 Cove Road application.
